title: chrysanthemum anserinifolium
intro: Chrysanthemum anserinifolium, commonly known as the goosefoot chrysanthemum, is a type of flowering plant in the daisy family native to Asia. This plant has been traditionally used for its medicinal properties, providing several health benefits such as reducing inflammation, relieving fever, and aiding in the treatment of respiratory issues like bronchitis and coughs. The therapeutic actions of C. anserinifolium are primarily attributed to its bioactive constituents, including flavonoids, terpenoids, and alkaloids, which have anti-inflammatory, antimicrobial, and antioxidant properties. The plant is also used to calm the mind and promote relaxation, making it a popular ingredient in herbal teas and remedies for stress relief.
